name: Schnitt 5.20.0
notes:
# Schnitt 5.20.0

Schnitt 5.20.0 fixes high-frame-rate export timing, imported transform timing, and the remaining blur and colour mismatches from Alight projects. Image to XML now produces editable shapes instead of vector outlines for simple icons.

## High-frame-rate export

Encoded frames now render at their exact sub-millisecond scene time instead of snapping to whole milliseconds. Transforms no longer repeat or skip at 120, 144, 240 or custom rates. Matroska and WebM use 10 microsecond timestamps for high rates, so 1/120 s and 1/240 s do not alternate between long and short frames.

Custom rates above the encoder's advertised range now cap only the rate-control hint. Every real frame timestamp is still written, so a 9999 fps export can start instead of failing while the encoder is configured.

## Imported projects

Imported scenes now upload the repaired document to the native renderer. Second-based Alight keyframes are normalized before preview and export, so positions, scales and retimed clips match the source at every timestamp.

Legacy Alight lens and zoom blur instances are repaired when opened: their centers, radii, strengths and keyframes are carried into the new radial blur. Effect colours, switches and point parameters keep their imported names and values.

## Image to XML

Traced rectangles, ellipses and rounded rectangles become editable native shapes instead of vector paths. Each traced colour island is emitted as its own top-level icon layer, including single-contour even-odd islands that used to fall back to vectors.

## Blur and colour

Zoom, lens, replace-colour, spot-colour, hue/saturation, RGB split, vignette, sharpen and displacement effects use the Alight sampling and colour maths. New radial blur and displacement controls are translated in every language.

## Downloads

- `app-arm64-v8a.apk` and `app-armeabi-v7a.apk` need Android 13 or newer.
- `app-compatible-arm64-v8a.apk` and `app-compatible-armeabi-v7a.apk` work on Android 7.0 and newer.
- `app-universal.apk` contains every supported 64-bit and 32-bit library for Android 13 or newer.

All APKs are signed with the same release certificate as 5.19.0.
